notes: Actual results reported to the State Comptroller for the fiscal year ending 2025-12-31, not an adopted budget.

Most records carry no dollar amount, so each documented program takes 2.5 points off the score (up to 10) instead of being counted as spending. Finding nothing earns no credit.

Red flags: 21 license-plate cameras are mapped inside City of Glen Cove's borders in OpenStreetMap (19 made by Flock Safety), not counting cameras tagged as run by stores, malls, schools or state and regional agencies. Flock cameras count as a red flag whoever runs them. Other brands count only when the town is the recorded operator, since many have no operator recorded.

redFlags.label: Flock camera network
redFlags.detail: 19 Flock Safety license-plate cameras are mapped inside City of Glen Cove's borders in OpenStreetMap. Flock cameras photograph every passing car and feed a search network shared with police agencies across the country. Who runs each camera is not recorded; cameras tagged as run by stores, malls, schools or state and regional agencies are not counted.
